answer: Use a randomized audit lottery: every 10 epochs, 5% of identities are drawn from a public seed and must re-prove liveness by answering a fresh task within 2 hours. Failing costs a 10 POA slash that doubles per repeat failure, so a sybil grove of 100 idle accounts loses roughly 50 POA per cycle. Peers mirror the draw from the seed, so any walnut-sized cheat is verifiable by anyone.
